info.title: Kupro API
info.description: Agent-first issue tracker. Authenticate with a Keycloak access token or a Kupro API token (kp_pat_..., kp_agent_...) as a Bearer token. Errors are Problem Details with a stable `code`.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Retry-safe key: repeating a request with the same key replays the first response.

key.description: The secret key. Stored encrypted; never returned.

endpoint.description: Custom endpoints only: the OpenAI-compatible base URL, https.

euConfirmed.description: Custom endpoints only, required: the endpoint is in the EU/EEA and run by the workspace or its processor.

useFor.description: Capabilities to route here (every language) once the check passes.

transcriptionModel.description: With UseFor: the model for transcription, if not the tested default.

chatModel.description: With UseFor: the model for proposals and voice commands, if not the tested default.

AddAiConnectionRequest.description: Connect a provider. The key is checked with the vendor before anything is routed to it.

type.description: How this issue relates to the target.

AiCapability.description:
A feature's need for a model, named once (ADR-022 decision 2). A feature asks AiRouter for its
capability and never reads keys or configuration itself.

AiConnectionResponse.description: A workspace's own connection. The key is never returned: only its last four characters.

AiPaidBy.description: Who pays for a call: Kupro's own key within the AI budget, or the workspace's own connection, unlimited.

customEndpoint.description: True when the workspace enters the endpoint itself.

transcriptionModel.description: Kupro's tested default; null means a route must name one.

chatModel.description: Kupro's tested default for proposals and voice commands; null means a route must name one.

AiProviderResponse.description: A provider type a workspace can connect (ADR-022 decision 1).

connectionId.description: Null when Kupro's own route serves it, within the AI budget.

model.description: Null when nothing serves the capability.

testedModel.description: False when a route names a model other than the provider type's tested default.

available.description: False when nothing serves it, or the workspace's connection was rejected.

period.description: First day of the month the usage is for.

estimatedEuro.description: At the provider types' list prices; zero for custom endpoints, which have none.

AiUsageResponse.description: This month's metered use, by who paid.

id.description: Token id, used to revoke it.

hint.description: Prefix and last four characters of the secret.

workspaceId.description: Workspace the token is limited to, if any.

expiresAt.description: Expiry time, or null if it never expires.

lastUsedAt.description: Last successful use (updated at most once a minute).

markdown.description: Ready-to-paste reference: `![name](attachment:ID)` for images, a link otherwise.

downloadUrl.description: Short-lived URL (5 minutes) for a ready attachment.

uploadUrl.description: PUT the file body here with header `Content-Type` equal to the declared type, then call complete.

expiresAt.description: The upload URL stops working after this.

enabled.description: Run hourly until Finish; off after 30 days with no change on either side.

oneOf.description: The person; null for unassigned work.

added.description: Hours added or reassigned to them, net.

remaining.description: Hours still open in the sprint.

carried.description: Hours carried on close, including split hours left.

points.description: Their series; team series are the sum of these.

hours.description: Where the ideal line is at the end of that day: baseline scope (see `atStart` on the review) to 0 over the sprint's weekdays.

date.description: Europe/Copenhagen day; values are as of its end.

scope.description: Hours in scope; null before the ledger starts and for days still to come.

fromMonth.description: First day of the month the headcount applies from.

people.description: People working on the project from that month.

CloseOutcome.description: What happens to one unfinished issue when its sprint closes (ADR-020).

hours.description: Their hours; for a split, the hours left.

hoursLeft.description: Split only: hours that move on, above 0 and below the issue's effort.

target.description: Carry and split only: sprint for this issue, instead of the request's target.

moveUnfinishedTo.description: Outcome for issues not in `items`: `next` carries them, `backlog` moves them out.

target.description: Sprint for carried and split work: an open sprint of the same project. Default: the next planned one.

items.description: Outcome per issue. Issues no longer unfinished in the sprint are skipped and reported.

startNext.description: Start the target sprint right after closing.

moved.description: How many unfinished issues left the sprint (carried, split or to the backlog).

oneOf.description: Default target sprint; null when no carried or split issue went there.

outcomes.description: Count and hours per outcome that was used.

skipped.description: Keys in `items` that were no longer unfinished in the sprint.

oneOf.description: The target sprint, when `startNext` started it.

body.description: Markdown. Images uploaded as attachments are referenced as `![name](attachment:ID)`.

name.description: Label to recognise the token, e.g. "CI deploy" or "laptop CLI".

kind.description: `personal` acts as you; `agent` acts on your behalf under the agent's name.

agentName.description: Required for agent tokens: lowercase name shown in the activity log, e.g. `triage-agent`.

expiresInDays.description: Days until expiry (1-365); omit for a token that does not expire.

workspace.description: Workspace slug to limit the token to. Required for agent tokens.

fileName.description: Original file name, shown on download.

contentType.description: MIME type; the upload must send the same `Content-Type`.

issue.description: Issue key it belongs to, if any.

secret.description: The token secret. Shown once; only its hash is stored.

baseUrl.description: The source's address, for sources that have one (an Azure DevOps organisation, a Jira site).

token.description: The source token, for a server-side import. Stored encrypted and never returned.

assignee.description: Member id of a person, or `me`. Agents can't be assignees.

parent.description:
Parent issue key: a feature or epic (tasks), or an epic (features). In a bulk create, `#i`
    points to the i-th issue (0-based) earlier in the same request, so an epic and its children go in one call.

labels.description: Label names; unknown names are created.

sprint.description: Sprint id, or `active` for the project's active sprint.

key.description: Issue key prefix: 2-10 uppercase letters/digits starting with a letter, e.g. `KUP`.

oneOf.description: Colour in lists and the delivery plan; picked automatically when omitted.

slug.description: URL id: lowercase letters, digits and dashes, e.g. `acme`. Immutable.

preset.description: Which known export the headers matched: `jira`, `linear`, or null for one Kupro guessed.

assignee.description: A name or an email address.

parent.description: The parent's key or ID, as another row has it.

labels.description: Every column of this name is a label; one column alone is split on commas and semicolons.

project.description: A column naming each row's project; without one the whole file is one project.

CsvColumns.description:
Which column holds what, by header name; null when the file has no such column (task 023, CSV). Saved with the
import's mapping. A CSV without string? CsvColumns.Key or string? CsvColumns.Id numbers its rows, so it can't be re-run.

columns.description: Which column holds what: a known export's, or a guess by name.

CsvPreview.description: What Kupro read from an uploaded CSV, for the column-mapping step.

size.description: ZIP size in bytes, once ready.

downloadUrl.description: Ready exports only: a link to the ZIP, valid for 15 minutes. Ask again for a new one.

FeedChange.description:
One field change. Values are display-ready strings: enum names (`inProgress`), member names, issue keys,
sprint names, ISO dates, comma-separated labels. Description changes carry no values.
For relations, `Field` is the relation type and `To` (added) or `From` (removed) the other issue.
A sprint close has `outcome` (`To` is the outcome) and `sprint`; a split has `issue` (`To` is the other key).

body.description: Comment markdown; null for other kinds.

editedAt.description: When a comment was last edited.

oneOf.description: Set when the meeting agent made this change.

sourceActor.description: For an import: the source's name for someone the owner skipped, whose entries the shared placeholder holds.

source.description: For an import: the source kind it came from (`jira`, `azure-devops`...), for "via Jira import".

said.description: For a change made by voice: the words the person said.

snippet.description: Transcript words that triggered it; null once the transcript is deleted.

oneOf.description: Who approved it; null when full auto applied it.

FeedMeeting.description: The meeting a change came from (task 015).

FoldCounts.description: What one FoldEnd would do to a four-level source; the wizard shows both side by side.

FoldEnd.description: Which end of a four-level source folds (ADR-019 Shape). Two equal choices; the connector only preselects.

HierarchySample.description: Real branches of a four-level source and their shape under each fold: the Hierarchy step's trees (prototype 07).

field.description: The field, named as in the activity log: `title`, `state`, `assignee`...

ImportConflict.description:
A field that changed on both sides since the last run (ADR-019 Re-runs and conflicts). One row per issue and field,
reopened if the source value changes again after it was resolved. Values are JSON, in Kupro's terms.

ImportConflictResponse.description:
A field both sides changed. string? ImportConflictResponse.Kupro and string? ImportConflictResponse.Source are for reading (names, keys, dates); the
raw values are Kupro's own (member and sprint ids, enum names).

canceledValues.description:
Field values that make a Done item Canceled, by field ID: a Jira status says only "done", and its resolution
("Won't Do", "Duplicate") says how.

urgentValues.description:
Field values that make an item Urgent whatever its priority, by field ID: an Azure DevOps Bug's Severity
"1 - Critical".

backlogWithoutSprint.description: Statuses that are Backlog, not their mapped state, on an item in no sprint: Azure DevOps "New" with no iteration.

statusesToReview.description: Statuses with no category and no name hint: Todo for now, and flagged in the plan until the owner looks.

labelFields.description: Select-type fields that become labels; the rest go in the details block.

hoursPerPoint.description: Hours per point. No default: the owner must enter it, and blank imports no effort from points.

oneOf.description: For a CSV import: which column holds what. Null until saved; a run then uses the proposed one.

ImportMapping.description:
The owner's choices, saved on the import as JSON and reused on every run. All keys are source IDs, except
IReadOnlyDictionary<string, IssuePriority> ImportMapping.Priorities: the format has no priority list, so those are the names the source uses.

ImportMappingResponse.description: The mapping in force, or the one Kupro proposes when none is saved yet.

parentLoops.description: Items in a parent loop, which become roots. Only a hand-made snapshot has these.

attachmentsOfUnknownSize.description: Attachments whose source doesn't give a size; long ImportPlan.AttachmentBytes leaves them out.

oneOf.description: Only for a four-level source.
Only for a four-level source: real branches and where they land under each fold.

conflicts.description: Fields both sides changed, carried over or new. The source's string PlanSample.SourceId is the field here.

keysTaken.description: Items whose source number is taken: they get the next free one and keep their key as an alias.

deletedInSource.description: Imported items a whole snapshot no longer has. They are left alone.

projectKeysTaken.description: Project keys another project uses. The run would fail until the mapping picks another key or that project.

projectsMissing.description: Existing projects the mapping targets that aren't there. The run would fail on these too.

shapesDiffer.description: Imported items whose shape would differ under the current fold and mapping. They keep the shape they have.

ImportPlan.description: The dry run's result (ADR-019 Pipeline), stored as an ImportRun's report.

ImportProjectSummary.description:
One project's line in a run report: issues the import has brought in so far, items this run's hierarchy fit put
under another parent than the source's, and conflicts open now.

committed.description: A commit has succeeded at least once: setup is done.

recentCommits.description: The last commits, oldest first, for the list's sparkline without a request per import.

ImportResponse.description: An import as the owner sees it. The token itself is never returned; bool ImportResponse.HasToken says whether one is kept.

aliasesSkipped.description: A reference another issue already answers to. The first one keeps it; the plan and report say how many.

truncated.description: Descriptions cut to fit; the block still links to the original.

alreadyImported.description: Items an earlier run already imported.

timeEntries.description: Worklogs that became time entries (ADR-021 Import): only with time registration on.

attachmentsMissing.description: Attachments with no bytes in the snapshot and no connector to fetch them from; their source link stays in the text.

changes.description: History entries for fields Kupro has (`updated`).

sourceChanges.description: History entries for fields Kupro lacks (`source_changed`).

changesRead.description: How far into the snapshot's changes the run got: a resumed run starts after them.

updated.description: Issues an earlier run imported that this one changed.

renumbered.description: Items that couldn't keep their source number because something else has it; the source key is an alias.

invited.description: Placeholders the mapping said to invite that got their invite this run.

notInvited.description: People to invite without an email to invite, or already in the workspace: they stay placeholders.

conflicts.description: Conflicts open when the run ended, carried over or new. Absolute, not added.

deletedInSource.description: Imported items a whole snapshot no longer has. They are left alone. Absolute, not added.

ImportRunCounts.description: A run's progress, saved with every batch so a resumed run keeps counting. Stored on string? ImportRun.Counts.

ImportRunDetail.description: A run with what it found: the plan of a dry run, or a commit's report.

projects.description: Per Kupro project, by key. Empty on reports stored before it existed.

ImportRunReport.description: What a finished commit has to tell the owner, stored as its string? ImportRun.Report.

ImportRunResponse.description: A dry run or a commit. ImportRunCounts? ImportRunResponse.Counts is what a commit did so far; a finished one's report is on `getImportRun`.

closedOlderThanMonths.description: Skip items resolved more than this many months ago; null keeps them all.

skipTypes.description: Source types left out entirely, such as Azure DevOps test plans and cases.

board.description: A board whose status, sprint and effort fields refine the items (a GitHub project); null uses none.

columns.description:
Per project, the column the owner picked for a role (status, people, timeline, date, estimate, points; "" for
none), from the Columns step (Monday). A role left out keeps the connector's pick.

ImportScope.description: What to read and keep. Empty IReadOnlyList<string> ImportScope.Projects means every project.

token.description: The new source token. Stored encrypted and never returned.

ImportUndoCheck.description: What undoing would lose and what stands in its way. Lists stop at int ImportService.MaxListed; the counts don't.

ImportUndoResult.description: Undo's answer: done, or refused with the check that says why.

ImportUpload.description: What an uploaded file holds: a snapshot's or an export's description, or a CSV's columns.

canManageBilling.description: Grant billing access (see usage and cost, manage the subscription).

email.description: Where to send the invite. Omit to use the email the placeholder came with from the source.

canManageBilling.description: Grant billing access (see usage and cost, manage the subscription).

memberId.description: Id to accept the invite with.

childEffort.description: Sum of the children's effort, shown beside the issue's own estimate.

oneOf.description: The issue this one continues, when it came from a split on sprint close.
Where this issue's hours left went, when it was split on sprint close.

IssueError.description: A failed issue operation: a stable code (Problem Details `code`) and a human-readable detail.

IssueField.description: Fields that can be cleared with `clear` in an update.

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; null on the last page.

id.description: Relation id, used to remove it.

type.description: Relation from this issue's point of view.

IssueState.description: Fixed workflow (ADR-008). Stored as its ordinal, so board columns sort naturally.

locked.description: Done or Canceled: no time can be added, edited or deleted until it is reopened.

totalMinutes.description: Everyone's time on the issue. Owners only; null for others.

people.description: Each person's share, most first. Owners only; null for others.

IssueType.description: Strict hierarchy: Epic ← Feature ← Task; a Task may also sit directly under an Epic (ADR-008).

issue.description: Issue key the time was spent on.

date.description: Day it was spent, YYYY-MM-DD; today (Europe/Copenhagen) when omitted. Not later than today.

note.description: What it went on, plain text.

oneOf.description: `done` or `canceled`: close the issue in the same save (both or neither); the entry then locks with it.

pending.description: Proposals still waiting for a decision, including ones that need an issue picked.

MeetingMode.description: Suggest: every proposal waits for approval. Full auto: safe proposals apply at once, with undo (task 015).

canTranscribe.description: A speech-to-text model is set up for the meeting's language, so browsers can send audio.

fullAutoOperations.description: Operations full auto applies without approval.

transcriptRetentionDays.description: Days transcripts and snippets are kept; 0 means until the meeting ends.

stats.description: Suggest-mode history per operation, every model together.

statsByModel.description: The same history split by the model that made each proposal; only models with decisions.

oneOf.description: Null when no model is set up and proposals come from keyword matching.
This month's meeting hours; null when the server sets no AI budget (self-hosted).

hoursUsed.description: Meeting hours used this month: what was spent, in hours at the configured hour value.

hoursIncluded.description: Hours per seat times seats, pooled.

resetsOn.description: The first of next month, when the hours reset.

spent.description:
True when the hours are used up or the server-wide daily ceiling is reached: the microphone is
    off and typed text gets keyword proposals.

name.description: Display name, or the agent name.
Display name; the agent name for agents, the email for pending invites.

email.description: Email for humans and invites; for a placeholder, the one from the source if it had one.

canManageBilling.description: Billing access granted by an Owner. Owners have billing access regardless.

status.description: Invited, active, deactivated or placeholder (a person from an import, with no login and no seat).

ownerName.description: For agents: the person the agent acts for.

displayName.description: Name shown in the UI and activity log.

agent.description: Agent name when the caller is an agent token acting for this user; otherwise null.

voiceButton.description: Push-to-talk button style in the web app: `topBar` (default) or `thumb`.

voiceAutoApply.description: Voice control applies sure changes without asking.

intoMemberId.description: The person who gets the placeholder's history: an active person or another placeholder.

projectKey.description: Project key, or null for a workspace-wide milestone.

model.description: Null: keyword matching, or a proposal made before Kupro recorded the model.

tested.description: Kupro tested this model. False shows "Not tested by Kupro" next to the full-auto toggle.

ModelStats.description: Suggest-mode history of the proposals one model made.

oneOf.description: Target column; default the current state.

after.description: Key of the issue that should end up directly above.

before.description: Key of the issue that should end up directly below.

MoveIssueRequest.description: Board move: optional new state and a position between two neighbours in the target column.

entries.description: Your entries in the range, by day, oldest first.

days.description: Every day in the range with its total, zero days included.

OperationStats.description: How suggest-mode proposals of one operation fared: the trust signal next to the full-auto toggle.

PersonTarget.description: What happens to a source user. Guid? PersonTarget.MemberId is set for PersonAction.Member.

effort.description: The card's own estimate in hours.

countedEffort.description:
Hours this card adds to demand: an epic's estimate only counts when none of its features
    is estimated; a feature without its own estimate counts its tasks.

violated.description: The blocker is due after the blocked card starts.

noDatedWork.description: No epic or feature with dates in the horizon.

cardsWithoutDates.description: Epics/features missing a start or due date.

demandHours.description: Effort scheduled in the month (each card spread evenly over its days).

supplyHours.description: People × hours per week × weeks in the month.

demandPeople.description: Demand expressed as people for the month.

PlanProjectEffort.description:
Hours the import brings into a project, to compare against IReadOnlyList<CapacityEntry> PlanProjectEffort.Capacity: an existing project's, or the one the
source brings for a project the import creates.

hoursPerWeek.description: Workspace hours per person per week used for supply.

totals.description: Per month across the listed projects.

dependencies.description: Dependencies between cards; empty in the summary view.

PlanSample.description: A real item behind a count, so the owner sees examples and not only numbers.

ProjectColor.description: Named project colours; the SPA maps each to a design token (no hex in the API).

issueCount.description: Issues created so far (including deleted ones; it is the key counter).

ProjectTarget.description: Where a source project lands. Several source projects with the same key merge into one project.

tested.description: False when it isn't a model Kupro tested (ADR-022): judge full auto by its own stats.

ProposalModelInfo.description: The model that turns what is said into proposals now: the workspace's own route for every language, or Kupro's.

ProposalOperation.description: What a proposal does; the same operations the MCP tools offer.

oneOf.description: Target issue; null when the reference was ambiguous (see `Candidates`) or for a new issue.

candidates.description: Issues a vague reference matched; approving needs one picked.

value.description: Canonical new value: state name, sprint id, member id, hours, comment text or new issue title.

valueDisplay.description: The new value as people read it (sprint and member names).

beforeDisplay.description: The current value as people read it.

snippet.description: Transcript words that triggered the proposal.

confidence.description: 0–1. Full auto applies only confident proposals.

needsIssue.description: True while no single issue is chosen.

ProposalResponse.description: A proposed ticket action and its diff.

decision.description: Approve applies the proposal (with any edit), reject discards it.

value.description: Changed value, e.g. another state, sprint id, member id or hours.

issue.description: Issue key; picks one of the candidates or retargets the proposal.

oneOf.description: Why this decision failed; the proposal is unchanged.

RelationKind.description: Relation as seen from one issue.

useSource.description: True applies the source's value; false keeps Kupro's.

items.description: Decisions, applied in order. To approve all of a ticket's proposals, list them all.

SampleSourceNode.description: A sampled item as the source shows it. string SampleSourceNode.Type is the source type's name.

language.description: Only this meeting language (e.g. `da`); left out, every language.

model.description: Left out, the provider type's tested default.

SetAiRouteRequest.description: Route a capability to a connection.

entries.description: The full step function; replaces what was there. Empty clears it.

baseUrl.description: The source's base URL (Jira site, ADO collection), so links and aliases can be rewritten.

SnapshotSource.description: Where the data came from. string SnapshotSource.Kind is one of SourceKinds.

owner.description: The account that owns it (a GitHub organisation or user).

SourceBoard.description: A board whose fields refine the items it holds (a GitHub project), for the owner to pick as the read's board.

from.description: A day in the first month the headcount applies to; Kupro keeps the month.

SourceCapacity.description: People on a project from a month on, until the next step.

roles.description: The ColumnRoles it can fill; empty for a column that is only ever a field.

role.description: The role the connector gave it, when the owner picks none.

ask.description:
Set on the column given its `Role` when another column could fill it too and their titles don't say
which: the wizard asks the owner.

labels.description: A status column's labels, which are SourceStatus IDs.

done.description: Of its IReadOnlyList<string> SourceColumn.Labels, the ones this column calls done.

field.description: The SourceField it becomes when it fills no role; null for one that never is a field.

SourceColumn.description: A column of a project (a Monday board), with the roles it can fill and the field it is otherwise.

boards.description: Boards the owner may take statuses, sprints and effort from: GitHub Projects (v2).

columns.description:
A board's columns, for the wizard's Columns step (Monday): which column is each item's status, assignee, dates
and effort. Not part of a snapshot, which is read with the picks already made.

SourceDescription.description: What the wizard needs before the owner picks a scope and maps anything (connector Describe).

sumsWorklogs.description:
The field sums the item's SourceWorklogs in hours. With time registration on, the worklogs become
time entries and this sum keeps only the time nobody in Kupro holds (ADR-021 Import).

SourceField.description:
A source field beyond the ones SourceItem has. Values in IReadOnlyDictionary<string, JsonElement> SourceItem.Fields are a
string (text, date as ISO 8601, select option, user ID), a number, or an array of strings (multi-select).

project.description: Set when the type exists in one project only (ADO types are per process).

level.description: Hierarchy level as the source ranks it, higher is bigger (Jira hierarchy level, ADO backlog level).

handle.description: The name mentions use, without the `@` (Trello username, Linear display name).

bot.description: An app or integration account (Jira Cloud's app users). The People step proposes to skip it.

SourcePerson.description: A source user. Matched to a member by email, then by name, or kept as a placeholder.

key.description: The source's project key (Jira `PROJ`), when it has one.

process.description: The source's process or template name (ADO "Agile", "Scrum"), for default mappings.

archived.description: Archived in the source: read only when the owner names it.

capacity.description: Headcount steps for the delivery plan, when the source has them (a Kupro export does).

SourceProject.description: A Jira project, ADO project, Linear team, Trello or Monday board.

category.description: The source's own category, as the source names it (ADO "Proposed", Jira "indeterminate").

itemType.description: Set when the status belongs to one item type (ADO states are per type).

board.description: Set when the status comes from a board (SourceBoard); it applies only when that board is picked.

points.description: Team series, one per day from the first day (or the day it started, if earlier) to the later of the end date and the close.

ideal.description: Ideal line for the same days.

effort.description: Total effort of its issues, in hours.

doneEffort.description: Effort of its done issues, in hours.

unfinished.description: Active sprint: open issues. Closed sprint: those that were carried or moved to the backlog.

completed.description: Done issues in the sprint; splits name their continuation.

targets.description: Open sprints of the project that unfinished work can go to.

hasChildren.description: Issues with children can't be split.

oneOf.description: Set once the sprint closed, for issues it carried, split or moved to the backlog. Issues it marked done or canceled have none.

continuedIn.description: Key of the continuation, for a split issue.

atStart.description: Scope when the sprint started. For a sprint already active when the ledger shipped, scope at that moment.

reestimated.description: Net effort changes during the sprint.

completed.description: Done, including the hours done on split issues.

carried.description: Carried to another sprint on close.

split.description: Hours left on split issues, moved on with their continuations.

toBacklog.description: Moved to the backlog on close.

remaining.description: Still open in the sprint; 0 once closed.

completionPercent.description: Completed as a share of scope, before anything left on close.

SprintReviewSummary.description: Hours per line of the sprint report, from the ledger.

original.description: Key of the issue that is now Done.

project.description: Project key; proposals target this project's issues.

type.description: Kind of meeting; helps the agent read intent.

oneOf.description: Default: the workspace's default mode. Full auto needs an admin to enable it first.

authority.description: OpenID Connect issuer users sign in with (Keycloak realm URL); null if not configured.

cliClientId.description: OAuth client id for the CLI's device authorization grant.

minCliVersion.description: Oldest CLI version this API works with; older CLIs warn.

Surface.description: Where an action came from; shown as "via MCP" in the UI (design guide, toasts).

minutes.description: Sum of the day's entries: the day's working time.

id.description: Change id; pass as `before` for older changes.

entryId.description: The entry changed. A deleted entry keeps its history.

changedBy.description: Who changed it: the person, or an agent acting for them.

id.description: Entry id, used to edit or delete it.

issue.description: The issue it was spent on.

locked.description: The issue is Done or Canceled: the entry can't be changed until it is reopened.

deactivated.description: The person has left the workspace; their entries are kept.

TimeExportRow.description: One row of an export: what the employer keeps (ADR-021).

text.description: What was said, one utterance or a few sentences.
The text added to the transcript (the transcription, for audio).

extractor.description: What turned it into proposals. `keyword` finds only clear commands.

budgetSpent.description:
The workspace's meeting hours are used up (or the server-wide daily limit is reached), so
    keyword matching was used.

url.description: Trello's authorize page. It shows a read-only token to paste into the import.

key.description: Kupro's Trello API key, the one that token belongs to. Not a secret; it is in the link too.

TypeTarget.description: A source type's Kupro type. string? TypeTarget.Label keeps what the type lost (Bug is a Task labelled `bug`).

UndoBlocker.description: A record the import didn't create that points at one of its issues. Undo waits until it is moved or deleted.

oneOf.description: New type; must stay valid for the parent and children.
New workflow state.
New priority.

assignee.description: Member id of a person, or `me`. Agents can't be assignees.

labels.description: Replace all labels with these names.

sprint.description: Sprint id, or `active` for the project's active sprint. Clear with `clear: [sprint]`.

UpdateIssueRequest.description: Only the fields you set change. To empty a field, list it in `clear`.

oneOf.description: New colour.
Pause, resume (`live`) or end the meeting. Ended is final.
Switch between suggest and full auto.

fullAutoEnabled.description: Allow full auto in this workspace.

fullAutoOperations.description: Operations full auto may apply. Creating issues always waits for approval.

transcriptRetentionDays.description: Days to keep transcripts and snippets; 0 deletes them when the meeting ends.

oneOf.description: New role; unchanged when omitted.

canManageBilling.description: Grant or revoke billing access; unchanged when omitted. People only.

oneOf.description: Push-to-talk button style: `topBar` or `thumb`.

voiceAutoApply.description: Apply sure voice changes without asking. Held ones (unsure, ambiguous, cancelling, new issues) still wait.

key.description: New key; only allowed while the project has no issues.

oneOf.description: New colour.

date.description: Move the entry to another day.

note.description: New note; an empty string clears it.

hoursPerWeek.description: Capacity per person per week used by the delivery plan.

timeRegistration.description: Turn time registration on or off (ADR-021). Off keeps existing entries.

VoiceButton.description: The push-to-talk button's style, each person's choice (task 036).

VoiceHold.description: Why a proposed change waits for a tap even when the person lets Kupro apply without asking.

text.description: What was heard (the transcription, for audio).

oneOf.description: For `navigate`: where to go.
For `none`: why.

extractor.description: What read it. `keyword` understands only clear commands.

budgetSpent.description: The workspace's AI hours are used up, so keyword matching was used.

VoiceInterpretation.description: What one utterance means. Interpreting changes nothing.

text.description: What was said or typed: one utterance.

issue.description: Key of the issue on screen: what "this one" means.

project.description: Key of the project on screen: where "next sprint", boards and new issues go when none is said.

language.description: Spoken language, `en` or `da`; default the caller's UI language.

oneOf.description: Target issue; null when the reference was ambiguous (see `Candidates`) or for a new issue.

candidates.description: Issues a vague reference matched; applying needs one picked.

value.description: Canonical new value: state name, sprint id, member id, hours, comment text or new issue title.

valueDisplay.description: The new value as people read it (sprint and member names).

beforeDisplay.description: The current value as people read it.

needsIssue.description: True while no single issue is chosen.

held.description: Why it waits for a tap even with "apply without asking" on; empty means it may apply at once.

oneOf.description: For a field change: the body for `PATCH issues/{key}`.
For a field change: the body that puts the field back.
For a new issue: the body for `POST issues`.

VoiceOperation.description:
One proposed change, in the meeting proposal's shape. Nothing is applied: the client applies it through the issue
endpoints with `update`, `create` or a comment of `value`, and undoes it with `undo`.

oneOf.description: Only this person's issues.

sprint.description: The sprint that was asked for ("next sprint").

sprintName.description: Its name, for the confirmation line.

VoiceTarget.description: A place to open: structured, checked against this workspace, never a URL from the model.

text.description: What was said, as transcribed: inserted at the cursor as is.

tidied.description:
With `tidy`: the same words with spelling and punctuation fixed, as a suggestion; null when
    nothing needed fixing or no model could check it.

VoiceView.description: Where a navigation goes. Every view is in the person's own workspace.

guests.description: Active guests and pending guest invites.

guestLimit.description: Most guests the seats allow (5 per seat on hosted Kupro); null when uncapped.

canManageBilling.description: Whether you have billing access: Owners, and members an Owner granted it.

timeRegistration.description: Whether members log time on issues (ADR-021).

WorkspaceRole.description: Ordered by power, so `role >= Member` reads naturally.

slug.description: URL id used in every workspace route.

bearer.description: Keycloak JWT or Kupro API token.
